vectors.name: weekly-hours
vectors.description: Weekly hours yield sorted UTC slots and a last slot ending exactly at closing.

vectors.name: lunch-break
vectors.description: Separate morning and afternoon ranges never offer a slot through lunch.

vectors.name: closed-weekday
vectors.description: A weekday without a rule is retained with an empty slot list.

vectors.name: closed-override
vectors.description: A closed override replaces the usual hours.

vectors.name: override-other-hours
vectors.description: An override replaces weekly hours rather than adding to them.

vectors.name: inclusive-override-dates
vectors.description: Override date endpoints are inclusive and can open a normally closed day.

vectors.name: new-service-buffers
vectors.description: New-service buffers must fit inside opening hours on both sides.

vectors.name: existing-booking-buffers
vectors.description: Existing booking buffer snapshots block the surrounding free time.

vectors.name: buffers-on-both-bookings
vectors.description: Both the new and existing booking buffers participate in conflict checks.

vectors.name: blocking-held
vectors.description: held blocks overlapping appointments but permits exact adjacency.

vectors.name: blocking-requested
vectors.description: requested blocks overlapping appointments but permits exact adjacency.

vectors.name: blocking-confirmed
vectors.description: confirmed blocks overlapping appointments but permits exact adjacency.

vectors.name: nonblocking-done
vectors.description: done never blocks free-slot calculation.

vectors.name: nonblocking-cancelled
vectors.description: cancelled never blocks free-slot calculation.

vectors.name: nonblocking-no-show
vectors.description: no_show never blocks free-slot calculation.

vectors.name: hold-expires-now
vectors.description: A hold expiring exactly at now no longer blocks.

vectors.name: expired-hold
vectors.description: An already expired hold no longer blocks.

vectors.name: hold-without-expiry
vectors.description: A legacy hold lacking an expiry fails conservatively by continuing to block.

vectors.name: imported-busy
vectors.description: Imported busy intervals block without storing titles or descriptions.

vectors.name: busy-with-new-buffers
vectors.description: The new booking buffers also avoid imported busy time.

vectors.name: step-15
vectors.description: A fifteen-minute grid produces quarter-hour appointments.

vectors.name: duration-does-not-fit
vectors.description: A final candidate is dropped when its duration passes closing.

vectors.name: busy-does-not-shift-grid
vectors.description: An off-grid busy interval never shifts the local-midnight slot grid.

vectors.name: adjacent-hours
vectors.description: Touching opening ranges form one continuous opening window.

vectors.name: minimum-notice-inclusive
vectors.description: A start exactly at now plus notice is allowed; earlier starts are dropped.

vectors.name: horizon-inclusive
vectors.description: The start at the exact horizon is allowed even when its end is later.

vectors.name: past-day
vectors.description: A past date remains present with no slots.

vectors.name: fully-booked-day
vectors.description: A fully occupied day remains present with no slots.

vectors.name: any-merge
vectors.description: Any merges duplicate times and picks the only free agenda when the other is busy.

vectors.name: any-fixed-sort
vectors.description: With equal workload, agenda sort wins over input order.

vectors.name: any-fixed-id
vectors.description: With equal workload and sort, stable ID wins over input order.

vectors.name: any-completed-workload
vectors.description: Completed appointments count as work done today without blocking their old times.

vectors.name: any-ignores-cancelled-workload
vectors.description: Cancelled, no-show and expired held appointments do not increase workload.

vectors.name: any-local-workload-day
vectors.description: Least-booked workload uses the local day rather than the UTC date.

vectors.name: inactive-agenda
vectors.description: Inactive agendas never contribute slots or hold-time choices.

vectors.name: ineligible-agenda
vectors.description: Only agendas attached to the selected service contribute slots.

vectors.name: inactive-service
vectors.description: An inactive service has no bookable slots.

vectors.name: unknown-service
vectors.description: An unknown service has no bookable slots.

vectors.name: unknown-agenda
vectors.description: An unknown requested agenda has no bookable slots.

vectors.name: zone-manaus
vectors.description: Opening hours use America/Manaus and return UTC instants.

vectors.name: zone-noronha
vectors.description: Opening hours use America/Noronha and return UTC instants.

vectors.name: utc-midnight
vectors.description: Local-date grouping survives a range whose appointments cross midnight UTC.

vectors.name: previous-day-buffer
vectors.description: A previous-day booking whose buffer crosses local midnight still blocks.

vectors.name: other-service-buffer-snapshot
vectors.description: Existing booking buffers are snapshots and do not borrow current service values.

vectors.name: dst-gap
vectors.description: A skipped local hour offers no imaginary times.

vectors.name: dst-fold
vectors.description: Repeated local times remain separate UTC appointments, each sorted by actual instant.

vectors.name: unavailable-pick
vectors.description: A busy instant or an off-grid instant has no hold-time agenda recommendation.

vectors.name: subminute-notice
vectors.description: A start even one millisecond before now is unavailable.

vectors.name: selected-agenda-isolation
vectors.description: Another agenda's bookings and busy blocks never affect the selected agenda.

vectors.name: override-is-scoped
vectors.description: Closing one agenda by override leaves other eligible agendas available.
